idea: A private household cash-flow planner for people with irregular income, with manual entry and no bank connection or financial advice
answers: Freelancers and hourly workers planning bill payments between variable paydays. They use notes and spreadsheets and want a private way to see their upcoming cash-flow gaps. The first test is an interview about planning habits.
results: For this disposable acceptance scenario, I interviewed six people with variable income; three agreed to try a manually entered cash-flow calendar. These are supplied test inputs, not verified market evidence.
